title: Stop losing the things you copy on Windows
caption:
Stop losing the things you copy on Windows 📋

Windows can keep a history of everything you copy:
✅ Press Windows + V
✅ Click Turn on
✅ Press Windows + V anytime to paste older copies
✅ Pin the ones you use every day

Did you know this one? 👇
